ci_scope: Primary descriptive screen: paired seed contrasts before averaging, not individual vehicles as replicates. SALib bootstrap mu_star interval (2000 resamples, seed 20261021, 95%) reflects trajectory uncertainty conditional on seed means only. Separately report five per-seed indices and leave-one-seed-out ranks; do not present SALib intervals as total stochastic uncertainty. Preserve broad/overlapping intervals and range dependence.
range_scope: Jointly vary ten continuous input controls. Demand remains a stress variable. No separate weather factor: speed/acceleration/deceleration/sigma are its constituent controls. Discrete lane restrictions, bottleneck edge-speed changes, offset redesign and geometry are outside this screen.
